class.name: PerformanceBudgetResult

method.name: get_checked_rule_count
method.description: Returns the number of rules that were checked (empty entries of [member PerformanceBudget.rules] are not counted).

method.name: get_exit_code
method.description: Returns [code]0[/code] if the budget passed and [code]1[/code] if it failed, for [method SceneTree.quit].

method.name: get_failure_count
method.description: Returns the number of failed rules.

method.name: get_failures
method.description: Returns the failed rules, in the order of [member PerformanceBudget.rules].

method.name: to_text
method.description: Returns a readable report: [code]"Performance budget passed (3 rules)."[/code], or a first line with the number of failed rules followed by one line per failure ([method PerformanceBudgetFailure.get_message]).
